# Resources / References / App Reference

> v6.5 documentation section. Applicability within this branch is unknown unless a linked page says otherwise.

[Branch index](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/llms.txt)

## Pages

- [App Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference.md): App Reference: The app reference document gives you an understanding of the app structure, functions, methods, events, variables, responses, and examples for building quality apps in Shopware.
- [Cart Manipulation script services reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/script-reference/cart-manipulation-script-services-reference.md): Cart Manipulation script services reference: The cart service allows you to manipulate the cart.
- [CMS Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/cms-reference.md): CMS Reference: Shopware developer documentation.
- [Custom Endpoint script services reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/script-reference/custom-endpoint-script-services-reference.md): Custom Endpoint script services reference: The cache service allows you to invalidate the cache if some entity is updated.
- [Data Loading script services reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/script-reference/data-loading-script-services-reference.md): Data Loading script services reference: The repository service allows you to query data, that is stored inside shopware.
- [Entities Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/entities-reference.md): Entities Reference: Shopware developer documentation.
- [Flow Action Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/flow-action-reference.md): Flow Action Reference: Shopware developer documentation.
- [List of all available Hooks for Scripts](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/script-reference/script-hooks-reference.md): List of all available Hooks for Scripts: All available Hooks that can be used to load additional data.
- [Manifest Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/manifest-reference.md): Manifest Reference: Meta-information about your app.
- [Miscellaneous script services reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/script-reference/miscellaneous-script-services-reference.md): Miscellaneous script services reference: The ArrayFacade acts as a wrapper around an array and allows easier manipulation of arrays inside scripts.
- [Payment Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/payment-reference.md): Payment Reference: This feature is only available starting with Shopware 6.4.1.0.
- [Product script services reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/script-reference/product-script-services-reference.md): Product script services reference: The PriceCollectionFacade is a wrapper around the calculated price collection of a product. It allows to manipulate the quantity
- [Script Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/script-reference.md): Script Reference: Script references include detailed explanations of the available functions, methods, arguments, responses, and samples.
- [Webhook Event Reference](https://developer.shopware.com/docs/v6.5/resources/references/app-reference/webhook-events-reference.md): Webhook Event Reference: Shopware developer documentation.
